CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2462 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 774e53f751c2c13e67b957cd7d05fd22b98f1fee. Bus nonce: 72ee57197001f8b1a60e103c7fa5f2f3. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 774e53f751c2c13e67b957cd7d05fd22b98f1fee`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 774e53f751c2c13e67b957cd7d05fd22b98f1fee` or `Fix review: blocked 774e53f751c2c13e67b957cd7d05fd22b98f1fee <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 72ee57197001f8b1a60e103c7fa5f2f3`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2462 774e53f751c2c13e67b957cd7d05fd22b98f1fee") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2462-72ee5719`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Policy PR: orchestrator.md section 13 and nudge.md step 18 now require looking up canonical instruments in tools/audit/seat/INSTRUMENTS.md before hand-rolling any loop, watcher, relay or helper; new helpers live in tools/; the sweep is rendered by sweep_render.py; briefs are re-checked when an instrument merges; a stateful instrument ledger is reconciled before switching. Caps are paid (no raise): check orchestrator.md/nudge.md stay within policy_budgets.json caps and that the trims removed no rule (diff each removed sentence against where the rule now lives, e.g. CLAUDE.md or nudge.md). Check policy_known_bad.json 6->1 is a genuine reduction. ## Approval must quote mandate 6175172275 verbatim.
